date.as_written: nepālavatsare yāte netraranddhrasamudrake | mādhavasya site pakṣe vacamyāṃ gurūvāsare || pitṛm eva ca nakṣtre

notes: The chronogram netra-randhra-samudra gives 2-9-7 (NS 792). The text identified in the colophon is Prāyaścittasamuccaya, whereas the catalogue record title is Śrīpuṣkarapārameśvarīmahātantra. 'vacamyāṃ' is a scribal error for pañcamyāṃ.
